EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Evidence Gaps

Evidence gaps using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

evidence_gaps(claims)

Example input

{
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim": "Tests passed",
      "evidence": [
        "log"
      ]
    },
    {
      "claim": "Production works",
      "evidence": []
    }
  ]
}

Example output

[
  "Production works"
]

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py evidence_gaps < examples/evidence-gaps.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
